JPMorgan Chase Names Bregje de Best to Succeed Jeremy Barnum as CFO

De Best joined JPMorgan in 2006 and has been finance chief of its commercial and investment bank since June 2025

By

JPMorgan Chase JPM -1.20 % decrease; down pointing triangle has designated Bregje de Best to succeed Jeremy Barnum as chief financial officer of the nation’s biggest bank early next year.

JPMorgan on Tuesday said Barnum, who has been finance chief since 2021, will become a vice chairman of the New York bank following the handoff, slated to occur after the company reports its first-quarter results.
